title: Chernobyl's shutdown button made it worse
caption:
AZ-5 was the emergency shutdown button. Because of a graphite tip on the control rods, its first few seconds added power instead. 🔴
Full video: [LINK]
Had you heard of the AZ-5 flaw?
sources: IAEA INSAG-7 (1992); World Nuclear Association, Chernobyl Accident 1986
